descFull: Aetox harness — where AI actually works on your computer. Real terminal and browser; documents and code in real projects; checks its work before saying done. Skills are tuned with the harness, so the model's strengths show. Data stays on your machine; the context architecture reaches every skill, tool and memory yet loads only what the job uses.
